nodes.text:
Complete quest #13669.

Wait for the maiden’s response, loot the Blade of Drak’Mar from the lily pads and return with the credited sword.

nodes.text: If Memory of Scholomance is not already unlocked, obtain Krastinov’s Bag of Horrors using the complete Heroic Scholomance rare guide. You may instead bring a player who uses that toy at the later bone pile.

recovery.text: Open the linked Heroic Scholomance guide for the full three-boss route and rare check. A friend using the toy is an alternative only when Eva actually appears; do not create ownership on this character.

nodes.text: For a new Spectral Essence, obtain three Dark Runes (20520) and five Essence of Undeath (12808), for example through a player-chosen Auction House purchase. Skip this preparation if you already have Spectral Essence.

recovery.text: Dark Rune is the tradable item 20520, not Demonic Rune. Auction prices are unknown until inspected; Toybox never buys or spends for you. Check bank storage for an existing unique Spectral Essence first.

nodes.text: Enter modern Scholomance and clear the path through its classrooms. Use Heroic if you still need the rare toy; with the toy available, the ritual’s modern dungeon visit can use Normal or Heroic.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

destination.label: Modern Scholomance entrance
destination.directions: Enter Caer Darrow keep and use the ordinary dungeon portal, not Eva’s Enchanted Journal.

nodes.text: In the first classroom, defeat Instructor Chillheart. If her body falls but combat continues, destroy the phylactery and stay ahead of the advancing ice wall.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Follow the dungeon passage into the illusion room and defeat Jandice Barov. When she splits, find and damage the real Jandice; leave the dangerous ground effects.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Continue into the bone-filled chamber and defeat Rattlegore. Click a bone pile for Bone Armor if Bone Spike threatens you; avoid the blue Soulflame patches.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Continue beyond the rare’s room to Lilian Voss. During her soul phase move away from the pursuing soul and the purple flames; let the scripted phases finish before continuing toward the headmaster.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Pass the Viewing Room and descend into Headmaster’s Retreat. Defeat Darkmaster Gandling. If Harsh Lesson teleports you away, clear the study-room enemies to return; dispelling a living subject can burst nearby undead.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: After Gandling, go to the upper central study room and stand by its bone pile. Use Krastinov’s Bag of Horrors, or have your companion use it there, to reveal Eva Sarkhoff. Remove the Surgical Alterations toy buff so she will speak to you.

recovery.text: The ordinary Caer Darrow ghost and the newly summoned dungeon Eva are different interactions. Check the upper room and bone pile, then remove the disguise. Continue only moves the cursor until her actual dialogue or item is observed.

nodes.text: Speak with the revealed Eva and exhaust her ritual dialogue. Receive Inert Spectral Essence if you do not already have Spectral Essence. Loot Eva’s Femur from the adjacent bones.

recovery.text: If no Inert Spectral Essence is offered, look for the existing unique trinket in bags or bank. Speak before trying to loot the femur; do not discard veteran items.

nodes.text: Before leaving, return to the Viewing Room. Walk behind the southwestern bookcase near the doorway and collect Eva’s Journal from its shelf.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Use Inert Spectral Essence with the three Dark Runes and five Essence of Undeath to restore Spectral Essence. Equip the restored trinket before looking for Caer Darrow’s ghosts.

recovery.text: Restoring consumes the listed materials and is a player action. If the trinket is already restored, equip it rather than making another. Inventory possession alone does not prove that it is equipped.

nodes.text: Collect the water bucket beside the fountain.

recovery.text: These ritual objects require Eva’s introduction. Keep the live ritual items; already exchanged items need not be collected again. If the object is absent, check Eva’s dialogue and whether the matching candle is already in bags.

nodes.text: With Spectral Essence equipped, speak to Joseph Dirte and trade Caer Darrow Fountain Water for Stinky Candle. Confirm the trade yourself.

recovery.text: If the ghost is invisible, equip Spectral Essence. Check the exact item and NPC; a trade consumes the memento. Do not infer it occurred from arrival.

nodes.text: Inside the town hall, take the deed from the wall.

recovery.text: These ritual objects require Eva’s introduction. Keep the live ritual items; already exchanged items need not be collected again. If the object is absent, check Eva’s dialogue and whether the matching candle is already in bags.

recovery.text: If the ghost is invisible, equip Spectral Essence. Check the exact item and NPC; a trade consumes the memento. Do not infer it occurred from arrival.

nodes.text: Find the doll beside the meat wagon’s wheel in Darrowshire.

recovery.text: These ritual objects require Eva’s introduction. Keep the live ritual items; already exchanged items need not be collected again. If the object is absent, check Eva’s dialogue and whether the matching candle is already in bags.

nodes.text: With Spectral Essence equipped, speak to Sammy and trade Trampled Doll for Ghost-Warding Candle. Confirm the trade yourself.

recovery.text: If the ghost is invisible, equip Spectral Essence. Check the exact item and NPC; a trade consumes the memento. Do not infer it occurred from arrival.

nodes.text: Take the painting from the wall by the end of the tavern bar.

recovery.text: These ritual objects require Eva’s introduction. Keep the live ritual items; already exchanged items need not be collected again. A later report conflicts with the five-candle source: if The Road Ahead is absent, try the ritual with the other gathered components and let the actual ritual requirements decide. nodes.text: With Spectral Essence equipped, speak to Artist Renfray and trade The Road Ahead for Imported Candle. Confirm the trade yourself.

nodes.text: Enter the living-side main gate. Take the left streets into King’s Square and collect the small shipment from the wagon behind the fountain.

recovery.text: These ritual objects require Eva’s introduction. Keep the live ritual items; already exchanged items need not be collected again. If the object is absent, check Eva’s dialogue and whether the matching candle is already in bags.

nodes.text: With Spectral Essence equipped, speak to Rory and trade Undelivered Shipment of Smokes for Tobacco-Filled Candle. Confirm the trade yourself.

recovery.text: If the ghost is invisible, equip Spectral Essence. Check the exact item and NPC; a trade consumes the memento. Do not infer it occurred from arrival.

nodes.text: Keep all five candles, Eva’s Journal and Eva’s Femur. In Caer Darrow keep, turn right instead of entering the modern dungeon portal; follow the corridor to the room with a floor grate and bones. Use Eva’s Journal to perform the ritual.

recovery.text: This room is outside the dungeon instance. Check all seven ritual items before using the journal. The ritual consumes them; the observed achievement/unlock, not Continue, establishes access.

destination.label: Ritual room in Caer Darrow keep

nodes.text: Click Eva’s Enchanted Journal on the ritual pedestal and choose to enter the Memory of Scholomance. If your account already unlocked it, begin directly here.

recovery.text: Use the book on the pedestal, not the ordinary blue dungeon portal. If it is absent, complete the ritual branch; an account achievement can support this specific account-wide unlock.

nodes.text: In old Scholomance, follow the dungeon corridors through the Reliquary toward the Great Ossuary. Defeat old Rattlegore below the ossuary and loot the Viewing Room Key if the Viewing Room door is locked; return upstairs and open that door.

recovery.text: The modern and original Rattlegores are different encounters. If the door is already open, use it. Do not clear all six final study rooms merely to reach the journal.

nodes.writtenDestination: Memory of Scholomance: follow the Reliquary corridors to the Great Ossuary. Descend into the bone pit for old Rattlegore and the key, then return upstairs to the Viewing Room door.

nodes.text: Inside the old Viewing Room, look behind Marduk Blackpool at the second bookcase from the left wall. Loot the small horizontal Familiar Journal from the upper shelf, partly obscured by other books.

recovery.text: This is the original dungeon’s Familiar Journal, not Eva’s ritual journal from the modern dungeon. Circle behind the shelf and inspect carefully; receiving or using Eva’s book does not grant this toy.

nodes.writtenDestination: Old Scholomance Viewing Room: behind Marduk Blackpool, inspect the second bookcase from the left wall. The small horizontal journal is partly hidden on an upper shelf.

nodes.text: Use Familiar Journal from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.

nodes.text: Enter normal Stratholme through its main northern gate in Eastern Plaguelands, leading to Crusader’s Square. The service entrance’s separate Gauntlet wing is not the supported route.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Follow the living-side streets toward Market Row and Festival Lane. Pass the short portcullis passage; if the rat trap closes its gates, clear the rats and wait for them to reopen. Search the steps and building overhangs around Market Square for neutral Hearthsinger Forresten.

recovery.text: Use the dungeon map and his name to search both sides of the street. He has several possible positions and may be absent. Do not use pre-Cataclysm service-gate shortcuts or assume a spawn timer.

nodes.writtenDestination: Normal Stratholme, living main-gate wing: follow Market Row toward Festival Lane and Market Square. Search the street steps and building overhangs for neutral Hearthsinger Forresten.

nodes.text: Defeat Hearthsinger Forresten and loot Piccolo of the Flaming Fire if it drops. If absent or no drop, leave and choose a fresh normal run only when the client permits an instance reset.

recovery.text: This is a random drop in normal Crusader’s Square. A kill is not toy receipt. Instance limits and reset availability come from the game; no fixed attempt count or hourly quota is invented.

nodes.writtenDestination: Normal living-side Stratholme: Hearthsinger has several possible positions around the Market Row/Festival Lane streets and building overhangs; loot the neutral rare after defeating him.

nodes.text: Use Piccolo of the Flaming Fire from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.

nodes.text: Defeat Orator Krix’vizk in the first plaza. Stay close enough for Chains of Oppression, avoid the Terrorize frontal, and move him out of Lingering Influence after Vociferous Indoctrination. Then continue southeast outside sentries’ detection circles toward Fangs of the Queen.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Approach the guarding sentry, move through it to aim its frontal away, then open Fliq’ri and buy Web Pet Leash yourself before the guard ejects you. Another player can distract the sentry instead.

recovery.text: If teleported away, return and reposition before retrying; the guard interaction is expected. Check the exact merchant, price and bag space. No purchase occurs merely because the vendor window opened.

nodes.writtenDestination: City of Threads: after Orator Krix’vizk, cross southeast outside sentry detection circles. Before Fangs of the Queen, take the right/eastern stairs to Fliq’ri and her guarding sentry.

nodes.text: Use a Druid for this class-restricted toy. Choose Firelands Normal or Heroic yourself and enter the raid in southern Mount Hyjal; inspect this character’s lockout first.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Clear trash through the opening Firelands field until Shannox and his hounds arrive. Defeat his patrol before continuing. Running past the field without spawning him leaves the later bridge locked.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Take the web-covered branch to Beth’tilac. Use the silk strand left by a Cinderweb Spinner to reach her web when necessary, then finish the encounter after she descends.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Take the volcanic path to Lord Rhyolith’s plateau. Damage his legs to steer him across active volcanoes and remove armor; finish him when he enters his final phase.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Continue to Alysrazor’s arena and begin the encounter at the feather/roleplay event. Handle the ground enemies and fire tornadoes, then defeat her through the burnout and re-ignition cycle if required.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: With the four outdoor bosses cleared, take the main path up to Baleroc and defeat him. Check the raid map for any of Shannox, Beth’tilac, Rhyolith or Alysrazor still alive before approaching the orb.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Behind Baleroc’s gate, use the Magma Orb to form the bridge. Cross to the keep and continue to Majordomo Staghelm’s courtyard.

recovery.text: The orb requires the preceding bosses; Shannox is commonly missed. If all five are dead but its dialogue is unavailable, preserve the save and report the obstruction rather than jumping around the gate.

nodes.text: Defeat Majordomo Staghelm in the courtyard and loot for Fandral’s Seed Pouch. Adapt the group’s spread/stack to his scorpion and cat forms; do not confuse the temporary Burning Seeds on the ground with the toy.

recovery.text: The pouch is a random drop, not a guaranteed reward for a Druid or a Burning Seed pickup. Normal and Heroic have separate current Firelands loot saves; respect each observed character/difficulty opportunity.

nodes.writtenDestination: Firelands: use the Magma Orb behind Baleroc, cross its bridge into the keep, and continue into Majordomo Staghelm’s courtyard before Ragnaros’s chamber.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.

nodes.text: Choose this character’s unused Normal, Heroic or Mythic Nighthold save yourself. For the direct Raid Finder alternative, speak to Archmage Timear in Legion Dalaran and request Betrayer’s Rise instead; that queue starts at Gul’dan.

recovery.text: The LFR wing and each standard difficulty are separate opportunities. A Mythic instance ID is a specific shared save; never accept or change it automatically.

nodes.choiceText: Choose the direct Betrayer’s Rise Raid Finder walkthrough

nodes.text: For a full standard run, enter the building at Suramar 43.3,62.3 and descend the underground passages/teleports. At the summoning stone take the right-hand route into the Nighthold, not the left route into the Arcway.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

destination.label: Underground Nighthold approach
destination.directions: Descend from the building. At the summoning stone turn right for the raid.

nodes.text: Follow the aqueduct route to Skorpyron. Defeat him, sheltering behind the crystal fragments for Shockwave if the encounter lasts long enough.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Continue along the aqueduct into the Chronomatic Anomaly chamber. If Power Overwhelming blocks progress, kill a Waning Time Particle, take its Temporal Charge and use Temporal Smash on the boss.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Follow the adjoining passage into Trilliax’s room. Defeat the construct, move with the Annihilation beam and clear required room hazards before using the way onward.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: In the central royal area, find Spellblade Aluriel’s patrol and defeat her. Keep the ice/fire/arcane marks away from other players until their indicated interaction is needed; handle the animated enchantments.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Take the route up Astromancer’s Rise into the Eternal Observatory for Star Augur Etraeus. Complete his changing celestial phases; handle the summoned void creature when it protects him.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Return to the royal area and take the Shal’dorei Terrace branch to High Botanist Tel’arn. Defeat the split forms, kill parasitic adds and leave the expanding Controlled Chaos circles.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Return to the central area and take the southeast Shattered Walkway to Krosus. Stay off the Fel Beam side, handle Slam circles with your group and move back from each bridge section before it collapses.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Backtrack to the Captain’s Quarters in the southwest and defeat Tichondrius. Shelter behind Fel Spires during Echoes of the Void; in his night phase kill bats and avoid the incoming nightmare attacks.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: After all eight earlier bosses are defeated, use the newly accessible Nightspire route. Speak to the available Image of Khadgar/teleport control where needed and enter Elisande’s chamber. Complete her time rewinds; cross Arcanetic Rings through the slowed sections near the time zones.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: From Elisande’s chamber, take the route to the rooftop Font of Night. Defeat Gul’dan’s opening lieutenants, then Gul’dan; remove Eyes before they multiply, move out of Fel Efflux and handle Bonds of Fel with the group. Mythic continues into The Demon Within: finish that additional encounter rather than leaving after Gul’dan falls.

recovery.text: If the roof route or encounter is locked, check every earlier boss and the selected save. On Mythic, wait for and finish the extra phase. Combat suitability is not inferred from level; use a suitable group if required.

nodes.text: Loot the completed Gul’dan encounter for Skull of Corruption. The target is a random toy drop; each eligible character/difficulty attempt remains separate.

recovery.text: Check all encounter loot and bag space. A kill, cinematic or achievement does not prove the toy dropped; use the game’s current lockout evidence before planning another attempt.

nodes.writtenDestination: Nighthold, Font of Night: after Elisande unlocks the final ascent/teleport, complete Gul’dan’s rooftop encounter and loot it here. Mythic’s extra encounter must also finish.

nodes.text: Use Skull of Corruption from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.
